stories.title: Repair every legacy task and requirement traceability gap
stories.journey: Reconcile every legacy story, including accepted and TBD stories, to real callable behavior, executable tests and required repair children without deleting scope.
tests: Set equality proves every legacy story ID is accounted for, not just selected prefixes.
Every requirement retains all original obligations and has mapped new repair tasks where needed.
Missing, unwired and unverified implementations cannot be counted as accepted release behavior.
Removing a task, test obligation, source surface or unexplained exclusion makes reconciliation fail.
Every repair has concrete dependency, ownership and test contracts; parent remains incomplete until all children integrate.

stories.title: Provider and multi-account routing features through the app
stories.journey: Expose native provider protocols, authorized account management, model catalog, fallback/combo routing, quotas, cache accounting and redacted diagnostics through the real engine/UI.
tests: OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-shaped streaming/tool fixtures execute real turns with normalized results.
OAuth and explicitly consented credential import use documented scopes and never impersonate unsupported clients.
Quota/rate-limit/fallback decisions preserve per-account budgets, retry safety and cancellation.
Input/output/reasoning/cache-read/cache-write accounting distinguishes unavailable values from measured zero.
Account removal and redacted debug export leave no secrets in logs, history, errors or child context.

stories.title: Session fork, rewind, sharing, memory and import parity
stories.journey: Use complete history workflows from the app: branch/fork/resume, rewind versus filesystem rollback, compaction, sharing and safe legacy import.
tests: Fork/rewind preserves immutable provenance and distinguishes message history from workspace effects.
Resume/retry/compact retain required tool call-result pairs and timestamps.
Sharing applies redaction, expiry/revoke and explicit authorization without leaking private context.
Import from a read-only copy never modifies the user's original database and handles large histories incrementally.
Retention, JSONL/SQLite reconciliation and crash recovery preserve durable user history within explicit quotas.

stories.title: Complete parent/child agent workflows through clients
stories.journey: Create/customize/delegate agents with foreground/background modes, cross-provider models, independent effort, persisted history and full child navigation/control.
tests: Spawn/fork/resume/retry/switch-model/steer child actions affect the intended persisted child and parent relationship.
Foreground waits and background execution follow explicit ownership and cancellation rules.
Context compression, messages and structured handoff preserve relevant context without copying secrets.
Admission of many agents uses bounded in-process tasks, fair queues and enforced account budgets.
Parent/child crash and cancellation release resources and never silently replay ambiguous tool effects.

stories.title: Tools, MCP, LSP, ACP, Git and PTY app integration
stories.journey: Use audited built-in tools, searchable MCP lifecycle controls, LSP diagnostics, ACP clients, Git/worktree operations and constrained terminal execution through actual callers.
tests: Tool discovery and enable/disable changes the tools actually sent to and executed for a model.
MCP handshake/reconnect/timeout and LSP diagnostics run against protocol fixtures with bounded lifecycle.
ACP stdio and versioned capabilities match real installed command behavior, including declared unsupported cases.
Git diff/worktree/patch operations preserve unrelated changes and require exact scope/approval.
PTY subprocess output, environment, working directory and cancellation obey sandbox and resource policy.

stories.title: End-to-end security on each supported OS
stories.journey: Prove deterministic policy enforcement for file/process/network/SQL actions, hooks and human-only authority on real supported platforms.
tests: Permission wildcard cannot bypass protected files, destructive operations or human-only grants.
Real platform sandbox denies env/secret access through direct paths, symlinks, inherited FDs and subprocesses.
Pre/post hooks and project configuration cannot grant authority or undo completed harmful actions.
Denied filesystem/process/SQL/network operations have no side effects, not merely error text.
Unsupported sandbox capability fails closed with honest platform limits rather than a regex masquerading as isolation.

stories.title: Skills, custom commands and plugin compatibility end to end
stories.journey: Discover/install/enable/use/disable skills, commands and plugins with native contracts and explicitly separate optional JS/UI compatibility.
tests: A custom command and skill affect an actual executed turn with correct precedence and scope.
Native plugin tools/hooks/UI contributions use versioned capabilities and real registered callers.
Unsupported Solid/TS UI plugins are not falsely advertised as native-compatible.
Optional compatibility host is sandboxed, resource-accounted and never starts in native-only mode.
Malicious plugin install/update/runtime input cannot alter security authority or escape granted paths.

stories.title: Existing web-product extras remain mandatory and functional
stories.journey: Complete the existing ChatGPT-class web requirements on the shared engine, including attachments, artifacts, workspace context, controls and declared voice/research features.
tests: Web prompt with attachment reaches the provider adapter and real authorized tool/approval flow.
Artifact edit/version/run/apply have actual safe implementations and accurate capability reporting.
History/branch/retry/model/effort controls share state with the TUI, not a parallel database.
Required voice/search/research journeys use real adapters with permissions, citations and explicit failure states.
Responsive keyboard/screen-reader operation, uploads and hostile rendered content pass browser/security tests.

stories.title: SDK, sync, remote proxy and headless protocol parity
stories.journey: Connect actual SDK/headless/workspace proxy clients to registered APIs with directory scoping, replay and documented compatibility.
tests: Typed SDK can start/attach the installed app and run an authorized scoped session.
Event projector replay rebuilds the same durable state without replaying ephemeral deltas as messages.
HTTP/WebSocket proxy preserves cancellation, bounded backpressure and authentication without arbitrary-origin forwarding.
Headless run/export and ACP streams have correct encoding, framing, exit and error semantics.
Schema/version changes are compatibility-tested against pinned fixtures and old supported clients.

stories.title: A-to-Z pinned-source and extra-feature differential gate
stories.journey: Certify each observable baseline behavior and explicit extra requirement against the installed app, with observed-dev changes classified separately.
tests: Every tracked upstream file and dynamically registered route/command/tool/config/event/platform surface has a disposition.
Each implemented surface has an executable test and trace to a user-visible app entrypoint.
Native V2, legacy compatibility, planned upstream and new requirements are distinguished; source TODOs are not working features.
Current-dev delta creates explicit adoption/defer decisions without silently changing pinned baseline.
Unknown surfaces, unmapped extras, unjustified exclusions and missing independent evidence block full parity certification.
